title: OKR Overlap Heatmap and Initiative Escalation Playbook
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Purpose: produce an operational artifact (Overlap Heatmap + Escalation Playbook) that makes company-level OKR ownership and failure modes explicit across Eng/Product/Design/Sales. The heatmap will surface initiative overlaps, single-point owners, and risk density; the playbook will define escalation lanes, SLAs for decision/triage, and contingency lanes (fallback initiatives or resource reallocation rules).

Scope: company-level OKRs only (top 8 objectives for FY25). Include mapping from objectives -> initiatives -> owners -> key dependencies. Deliverables: 1) Overlap Heatmap (spreadsheet + interactive Confluence embed), 2) Escalation Playbook (PDF + Confluence runbook), 3) One-pager comms for exec sync, 4) Template for quarterly import into roadmap tooling.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Heatmap shows overlap score for each initiative pair and flags initiatives with >2 high-priority overlaps.
- Each flagged initiative has a named escalation owner and a fallback lane defined (e.g., degrade scope, shift headcount, activate Dedicated capacity effort).
- Playbook contains triage steps, RACI for decisions, and a 72-hour initial response SLA for high-impact incidents.
- Exec one-pager reviewed and signed off by Head of Product and Head of Eng.

Non-goals: This ticket does not remake lower-level OKR structures for individual teams or change AR/PR process for resource requests.

Links and artifacts: 
- Working heatmap (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/OKR-Overlap-Heatmap
- Draft playbook (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/okr-escalation-playbook
- Roadmap import template (CSV): https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmaps/blob/main/okr-import-template.csv
